description: This file defines React hooks for managing products within a frontend application. It includes hooks for fetching products, managing search state, and performing CRUD operations on products via an API. The file relies on React's state management and side effects, and interacts with the ProductsAPI for server communication.

methods.name: useProducts()
methods.description: Hook for managing products list with loading, error handling, search query, and refresh capability.

methods.name: useProductActions({ onUpdated } = {})
methods.description: Hook to perform create, update, delete, and image upload/delete actions on products, optionally calling an onUpdated callback after successful operations.
